sections.title: Introduction to Creative Writing: Poetry and Memoir
sections.description: This workshop-style course will serve as an introduction to writing poetry and memoir. Students will craft their own original pieces, and we will read and comment on each other’s work as well as on assigned readings. In addition to regular workshops of student work, we will be using in-class exercises to push the boundaries of our own writing. Course requirements include thoughtful and committed class participation, regular writing assignments, and a final portfolio of writing.
